document_seeds.content:
# Property Launch Brief

Project: [project]
Objective: generate qualified leads and reduce financing/location objections.
Audience: first-home couples, family upgraders, investors, and local community stakeholders.
Proof: location facts, construction milestones, financing assumptions, legal terms.
Risks: affordability concerns, location skepticism, delays, community backlash.
Validation: legal review, lead consent review, objection test by segment, sales team readiness.

channel_behavior: Facebook and LINE carry buyer questions and resident concerns
Instagram shows lifestyle but needs factual backing
TikTok can surface construction concerns quickly
competitor_archetypes: Premium developer with stronger brand trust
deep_preset.sample_brief: Launch a new property project with clear affordability proof, verified location facts, and community-impact guardrails.
sample_risk_checklist: Are fees and booking terms clear?
assumptions: This preset models communication risk and lead intent, not property valuation.
Actual financing and legal details must be supplied by the project team.
limitations: Does not provide investment advice or guaranteed sales forecasts.
Does not replace legal, EIA, or sales contract review.
